template: directive: plan/bearings.md § Article hero art — keycap piece maps to keycap profile silhouette; brief specified an MT3 sculpt-curve row rather than a Cherry/OEM/SA/MT3 comparison
subject: Five MT3-profile keycap side silhouettes (R1-R5) drawn adjacent as a physical row, each with the characteristic MT3 steep-walled body and deep scooped dish top. Row heights and top-edge tilt vary per position to trace the sculpted-set 'mountain curve' — tall and back-raked at R1, peaking at the R3 home row, shortening and forward-raked toward R5 — echoed by a faint dashed cylindrical reference arc behind the row. Small mono row labels (R1-R5) sit beneath each cap; a 'MT3 /DEV/TTY' mono print references the restocked set's beamspring/teletype-inspired naming (Drop's MT3 /dev/tty set: dye-sub PBT, cream and charcoal colorway, modeled on IBM beamspring caps). No color blocking beyond the single splash — the cream/charcoal colorway is implied by the mono print treatment and restrained line work rather than literal fill colors, per the family's single-splash rule.
